title: Intourist Residence — 2+1 apartment
description: 2+1 apartment in the Intourist Residence residential complex. Address: Batumi, 17 Pirosmani St., block B. 11th floor, 81.2 m². Direct sea view, three balcony exits, 100 m to the sea. Heroes Alley, restaurants, cafés, supermarkets and pharmacies within walking distance. New designer renovation — never lived in. Underfloor heating with individual Wi-Fi thermostats, Wi-Fi touch switches. Ceiling ventilation system with outlets to the corridor, walk-in closet and balcony. Powerful compressor boosting extraction above the cooktop. Wi-Fi air conditioners in every room. Fully equipped with premium Samsung and Bosch appliances: Samsung dishwasher, Bosch washer and dryer, large Samsung fridge, Bosch cooktop and oven. Bathtub and separate shower. Price: $200,000.
address: Batumi, 17 Pirosmani St., block B (Intourist Residence)
